reason: I already have Zapier and HubSpot doing most of this, and I'm not letting an AI answer my customers until I've seen exactly what it says. I might poke at the free plan, but I won't pay 99 € a month for it this month.
objection: One wrong or weird reply from an AI 'support manager' to a good client and my reputation takes the hit, not FLUGIA's. On top of that, 'connects to the tools you already use' is vague: I want the actual integration list and to know if it works with Zapier/Make and HubSpot, and what a 'credit' actually buys.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial where every customer-facing message waits for my approval before sending, plus a clear HubSpot and Zapier integration and an honest example of what 100 credits gets me in a month.
